text:
maria: Customer acme-inc reports SSO failures right after their IdP rotated signing cert. Symptoms: users hit 403 on login, our logs show 'Recipient mismatch'. Anyone picking this up?

sam: on it — can you paste the exact error and the ACS URL they're calling?

maria: log snippet from our sso-svc: 
```
SAML validation failed: Recipient check failed
expected: 'https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs?org=acme-inc'
received: 'https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs'
IdP cert thumbprint (old): AB:CD:12:34:...
IdP cert thumbprint (new): EF:01:23:45:...
RelayState: 'https://app.acme-inc.com/dashboard'
```
They say curling the exact URL (with querystring) works locally.

jordan: that looks like our edge is dropping the querystring before forwarding to sso-svc. Our Recipient check is strict (includes querystring) so when QS is stripped assertions fail. Also possible metadata cache still had old cert during rotation. Two simultaneous issues.

sam: can we confirm forwarded path from our proxy logs?

jordan: checked edge logs for that timeframe — upstream request path logged as `/saml/acs` (no `?org=acme-inc`). Proxy id 42 shows `proxy_forwarded_path=/saml/acs`.

devops-anna: I can push a proxy config change to preserve the full request URI and also flush the IdP metadata cache for acme-inc. Will do staging first.

maria: customer also provided their LB logs: `GET /saml/acs?org=acme-inc HTTP/1.1` so they are sending it.

jordan: nginx snippet we had previously used `proxy_pass http://sso-internal/;` which drops args. Change to use `$request_uri`. Example: 
```
location /saml/acs {
  proxy_pass http://sso-internal$request_uri;
  proxy_set_header Host $host;
  proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
}
```
This preserves the querystring.

devops-anna: patched staging, smoke tests pass. Flushed metadata cache for org `acme-inc` via admin UI and restarted sso-svc container.

deploy-bot: deployed `nginx-proxy` fix to prod (rollout id: 5423) at 2350012360.

support-bot: Notified acme-inc that we're rolling a fix and asked them to retry.

sam: after deploy+cache flush we see successful SAML validations: Recipient matches and signature verification using new cert EF:01...

maria: customer confirmed login flows working again. All green. :tada: 

jordan: root cause summary: (1) edge proxy was stripping querystring, causing Recipient mismatch; (2) IdP cert rotation + our metadata cache meant a short window where old cert was still used.

actions: - fix proxy to forward `$request_uri` (deployed) - add admin API to force metadata reload per-org (added) - add alert when SAML signature failures spike for a tenant (todo)

maria: marking resolved and will file a short postmortem. Thanks all :thumbsup:
